name: isUnit_of_one
statement: Integers v O) {x : O} (hx : IsUnit (algebraMap O R x)) (hvx : v (algebraMap O R x) = 1) : IsUnit x

name: dvd_of_le
statement: Integers v O) {x y : O} (h : v (algebraMap O F x) ≤ v (algebraMap O F y)) : y ∣ x

have_tree.type: v ((algebraMap O F y)⁻¹ * algebraMap O F x) ≤ 1
